fish.habitat: Swims in large schools in coastal open water. Young fish eat phytoplankton; adults eat larger plankton, including fish and shrimp larvae.
Small fish living in the water column of coastal waters; several species form schools.
Generally lives near the seabed in shallow coastal waters over sand or mud. Habitat varies among ponyfish species.
Lives near sandy or muddy seabeds in coastal marine waters. The different species occupy different depths.
